_om: Pakketyven in English (Parcel Pincher, rusj.no/en/parcel-pincher/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. British English; ‘pinch’ is the game's word for stealing a parcel. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
